assessment: This paper combines evolution experiments with genomic analysis of environmental samples to study the evolution of colistin resistance in Escherichia coli. It highlights the importance of pre-existing genomic variations on the chromosomes of clinical strains in driving the evolution of antibiotic resistance. The results are relevant for clinical and non-clinical microbiologists studying antibiotic resistance to last-resort drugs like colistin. The design of the research is simple and elegant, and the genomic data analysis connects the in vitro findings to the real world.
